title: contracts/subscriptions.json
description: The app's subscription facts, read by the subscriptions-revenuecat skill's check-revenuecat.mjs. The ids are written once and must match the RevenueCat dashboard and both store consoles.

entitlementId.description: The RevenueCat entitlement that unlocks Premium (for example premium).

offeringId.description: The offering the paywall shows (RevenueCat's current offering).

packageIds.description: Package ids by period, for example { monthly: $rc_monthly, annual: $rc_annual }.

productIds.description: Store product ids by period; never reused once created.

familyShareable.description: Family Sharing; once on in App Store Connect it can never be turned off. Default false.

adapterFile.description: The one file that imports react-native-purchases (default src/services/subscription/revenuecat-subscription-adapter.ts under the layout's servicesDir).

sdkImportersAllowed.description: Extra repo paths allowed to import react-native-purchases-ui (a RevenueCat paywall view), each a deliberate decision.

serverDirs.description: Folders that hold server code (server/src, or functions/src with Firebase); scanned for client entitlements used as server decisions.

webhookFiles.description: The webhook handler file(s): checked for the Authorization check and the event-id claim.
